reports.text: Margaret, 81, has dementia and left home on foot this afternoon without telling anyone. A neighbour saw Margaret set off towards the north. Family say Margaret walks slowly and tires quickly.
A dog walker reports seeing someone matching Margaret's description about 10 minutes ago, roughly 0.5 km north of the house, in open fields.

hypotheses.name: North slow walk - tired close by
hypotheses.reason: Followed reported northerly departure but tired quickly and stopped nearby.

hypotheses.name: Disoriented other direction
hypotheses.reason: Dementia confusion or mistaken neighbour report, went a different direction.

hypotheses.name: Water attraction hazard
hypotheses.reason: Vulnerable older adult with dementia at risk near streams and ponds.

hypotheses.name: Continued north through open fields
hypotheses.reason: Both the initial direction and recent sighting place her north in open fields, still moving slowly outward.

hypotheses.name: Stopped to rest near sighting location
hypotheses.reason: Slow tiring walker may have stopped shortly after sighting and remains very close to last seen point.

hypotheses.name: Disoriented wander off expected line
hypotheses.reason: Dementia can cause random turns, so sighting could be mistaken or she left the north line and is short distance in another direction.
